item.title: Hands Free Kitchen Timer
item.description:
Hands Free Kitchen Timer

For my mechanical design class, I designed the software using an Arduino Uno to create a pre-production prototype handless kitchen timer. It utilizes an ultrasonic sensor for distance sensing and can be used for not only those with dirty hands, but also disabled people and elderly with issues being tactile.

item.title: STEP
item.description:

During this time, I will be working on a team of students to provide consulting and marketing services to a local foreign investment agency.

item.title: Driver Selectable 4WD
item.description:
Driver Selectable 4WD

Dec 2025

I had the oportunity to work on the Ohio State Baja Buckeyes’ drivetrain. Our team wanted to implement a driver selectable 4WD system and redesigned the front gearbox as well as selector to accommodate based off the first iteration of the system.
